name: awesome-software-architecture
desc: A curated list of resources on software architecture

resources.name: Flexibility
resources.desc: Able to adapt to changes in both environment and usability requirements without encompassing structural changes.

resources.name: SOLID
resources.desc: Lend to developing software with considerations for maintaining and extending as the project grows

resources.name: Ports and adapters pattern
resources.desc: Decouple the application core logic from the services it uses.

resources.name: Observer pattern
resources.desc: One-to-many state change notification.

resources.name: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software, by Gamma et al
resources.desc: The one that started it all :orange_book:.

resources.name: Software Design Patterns: A Guide
resources.desc: Introduction to common software design patterns.

resources.name: CQRS
resources.desc: Segregate operations that read data from operations that update data by using separate interfaces.

resources.name: Event Sourcing
resources.desc: Instead of storing just the current state of the data in a domain, use an append-only store to record the full series of actions taken on that data.

resources.name: Feature Toggles
resources.desc: Feature Toggles (often also refered to as Feature Flags) are a powerful technique, allowing teams to modify system behavior without changing code.

resources.name: Behavior Driven Development (BDD) and Functional Testing
resources.desc: BDD uses human-readable descriptions of software user requirements as the basis for software tests.

resources.name: N-tier architecture style
resources.desc: Layers are a way to separate responsibilities and manage dependencies.

resources.name: Circuit Breaker
resources.desc: Protecting failing resources to prevent cascading failures.

resources.name: Bulkhead
resources.desc: Partition resources to isolate failures.

resources.name: Leader Election
resources.desc: Coordinate distributed workloads by electing a leader.

resources.name: No silver bullet, by Brooks
resources.desc: Making a case for growing software in small increments :orange_book:.

resources.name: Clean Architecture, by Martin
resources.desc: Key principles and concepts for building sustainable and maintainable software :orange_book:.

resources.name: Technical Debt, by Fowler
resources.desc: Cost and impact of accumulating technical debt.

resources.name: The Magic Tricks of Testing, by Metz
resources.desc: Minimalistic ideals as a practical and pragmatic approach to software testing 🎥.

resources.name: TDD, Where did it all go wrong?, by Cooper
resources.desc: Suggestion on TDD practices and boundaries to reduce coupling 🎥.

resources.name: arc42
resources.desc: Template for documentation and communication of software and system architectures.

resources.name: Architectural Decision Records
resources.desc: Version and document architectural decisions the same way you do with code.

resources.name: Documenting architecture
resources.desc: Pragmatic tips on how to effectively document software architecture.

resources.name: Event Storming
resources.desc: Format for exploring domain driven-design.

resources.name: MoSCoW Prioritization
resources.desc: Fast and dead-simple way of prioritizing requirements.

resources.name: Story mapping
resources.desc: Visualize your requirements by creating story maps.

resources.name: Impact mapping
resources.desc: A strategic planning technique used for building products and delivering projects.

resources.name: Business Model Canvas
resources.desc: Business plans made simple and visual.

resources.name: Business Model Generation, by Osterwalder & Pigneur
resources.desc: Easily visualize your value proposition, costs and revenue streams :orange_book:.

resources.name: The C4 Model
resources.desc: Describe software using Context, Containers, Components and Code.

resources.name: Wikipedia: Data modeling
resources.desc: Great, short, introduction to data modeling.

resources.name: Sparx Systems Enterprise Architect
resources.desc: Object-oriented modelling suite. Only available natively for Windows.

resources.name: Visual Paradigm
resources.desc: Similar to Enterprise Architect. Available for multiple platforms.

resources.name: Lucidchart
resources.desc: Paid cloud-based diagram editor. Available on all common platforms.

resources.name: Draw.io
resources.desc: Free and simple diagram editor. Comparable to Visio and its likes. Available on all common platforms.

resources.name: Structurizr
resources.desc: Modelling tool based on the C4 Model (see above).

resources.name: PlantUML
resources.desc: Like markdown for diagrams, PlantUML renders an english-like grammer into diagrams.

resources.name: PlantUML for Atlassian
resources.desc: Adds support for PlantUML-based diagrams in the atlassian suite.

resources.name: Sketchboard.io
resources.desc: Collaborative sketchboarding.

resources.name: ERD Lab
resources.desc: Free cloud based entity relationship diagram (ERD) tool made for developers.

resources.name: Pumler
resources.desc: Real-time collaborative text-to-diagram editor for PlantUML, Mermaid, and Structurizr (C4), with browser-based PNG/SVG export.

resources.name: Scrum
resources.desc: Framework for developing and maintaining complex products.

resources.name: SAFe
resources.desc: Scalable agile framework.

resources.name: Nexus
resources.desc: Scalable Scrum according to Ken Schwaber, co-creator of Scrum.

resources.name: The death of Agile, by Allen Holub
resources.desc: How "Agile" has moved away from the basic principles of agility, and what we need to do to fix things 🎥.

resources.name: Agile Architecture Pt. 1, by Allen Holub
resources.desc: How do we work with architecture in a agile world 🎥.

resources.name: Agile Architecture Pt. 2, by Allen Holub
resources.desc: How do we work with architecture in a agile world 🎥.

resources.name: Wikipedia: Lean Software Development
resources.desc: Translation of lean manufacturing for the software development domain.

resources.name: Rolling rocks downhill, by Clarke Ching
resources.desc: Business novel about agile and lean software development :orange_book:.

resources.name: The Goal: A Process of Ongoing Improvement, by Goldratt
resources.desc: Business novel about contiuous improvements in a manufacturing setting. Easily adaptable to software development as well :orange_book:.

resources.name: Extreme Programming
resources.desc: The most specific of the popular agile processes, focusing on engineering and development practices.

resources.name: Wikipedia: DevOps
resources.desc: Combining software development and operations practices to shorten time to market while maintaining high quality.

resources.name: The Phoenix Project, by Gene Kim et al
resources.desc: IT, Devops and helping your Business win :orange_book:.

resources.name: The Unicorn Project, by Gene Kim
resources.desc: Developers, Digital Disruption and Thriving in the Age of Data :orange_book:.

resources.name: Keep CALMS and carry on
resources.desc: How BPDTS use the CALMS model as a reference for their devops adaptations.

resources.name: Chaos Engineering at Netfix
resources.desc: Chaos Engineering is a new discipline within Software Engineering, building confidence in the behavior of distributed systems at scale 🎥.

resources.name: Adidas DevOps Maturity Framework
resources.desc: Based in the C.A.L.M.S. definition of DevOps, the framework defines a set of capabilities and guidelines that when adopted, increases efficiency, effectiveness and happiness of the team.

resources.name: How to learn software design and architecture - a roadmap
resources.desc: Additional things helpful to learn to get a firm understanding of software architecture.

resources.name: Software Architect Roadmap
resources.desc: A complete and structured guide to become a Software Architect.
